notes: The community gallery behind fonebrew.com/loops. Every entry points at a real .bpmn file under apps/fonebrew-com/public/loops/gallery/, and every field here is either read from that file's own <aarso:meta> provenance or is site metadata (author, tags, accent). The three seed entries are examples written to demonstrate the format, not distillations of any published method: their distilledBy says 'hand-authored' because that is what happened. See CONTRIBUTING.md in apps/fonebrew-com for how a loop gets added.
